compared.difference: Public 275 (lemma-cohomological-descent-finite) builds the augmented cosimplicial complex of the Cech nerve of a surjective finite morphism of schemes and uses finite-pushforward acyclicity; the present task proves the general Cech-to-cohomology spectral sequence of any covering on any site, whose proof instead goes through injective resolutions and a double complex. Neither statement implies the other as stated.

Public 2869 replaces ordered Cech intersections by unordered configurations of distinct points on algebraic spaces with sign local coefficients; the present task is the unordered-free, coefficient-free spectral sequence of an arbitrary covering on a site.
Public 291 counts fppf hyperdescent for unbounded quasi-coherent complexes, a different statement and a different technique.
